text:
anya: quick check — we have a 6hr training window scheduled Tue 09:00 UTC that needs 8x H100 in us-west1. Vendor portal currently shows only 4 available. can we get a burst? also pinging for PR #4231 approval so entitlement can be bumped :pray:
mike: heads up — i flagged PR #4231 in the review queue, small terraform change to entitlement counts. awaiting one more +1, should be quick. i can take it after standup if nobody else does :thumbsup:
jordan: @anya which project? is this for the embeddings-retrain or the multimodal demo? affects priority for allocation
anya: embeddings-retrain (daily sweep). high priority for qps baseline evals but not blocking prod. if we can't get h100, fallback plan is 16x a100 in burst mix (higher latency)
raquel: pinged our vendor contact (sent email) and opened a provisional hold in the vendor portal for 8 units for 2h. vendor said they can try but need final confirmation by EOD UTC
vendor-bot: [vendor-portal] provisional hold created: hold_id=VH-98321, expires=2026-04-14T23:00:00Z, units_requested=8, region=us-west1
anya: thanks raquel. can we also check cross-cloud allocation? GCP shows limited, AWS might have spare. mike can we get a quick cost/latency calc for a mixed fleet if needed?
mike: quick back-of-envelope: 8x h100 us-west1 ~= $X/hr, fallback 16x a100 (split across gcp+aws) adds ~20% token latency and ~35% cost. i can post numbers in a follow-up comment after lunch
jordan: ops-oncall — any objections to spinning up a mixed pool for this run (temp add AWS accounts)? security wise ok for embeddings testing, right?
ops-oncall: short answer: fine for dev/testing. need a ticket for cross-cloud keys and egress rule check. create JIRA and tag infra-oncall, i'll expedite the key rotation rule if needed
tanya: FYI PR #4231 has one outstanding comment about the variable name in modules/entitlement.tf. trivial. @mike or @anya can you resolve?
mike: will resolve now, assign back for review.
anya: resolving the module var name now. also leaving a note for the run: set BATCH_SIZE=128, seq_len=2048, run-id=embs-sweep-2026-04-15
raquel: vendor emailed back — they can commit 8 H100 for the window if we confirm by 18:00 UTC. also suggested a spare 4x H100 on hot-standby that could be promoted if needed
jordan: great. can we get the provisional hold extended to cover the final confirmation window?
raquel: submitted extension request (portal). confirmation pending.
vendor-bot: [vendor-portal] extension_request_received: hold_id=VH-98321, requested_extension_hours=4
anya: ok let's do this flow: 1) mike merge PR #4231 by EOD 2) raquel confirm extended hold 3) ops-oncall create cross-cloud ticket if we need AWS 4) i'll post run config and kickoff note. anyone object?
tanya: lgtm, no objections
mike: merging in 5 after i fix var name
ops-oncall: i'll stand by for the JIRA and can approve keys within 2hrs of request
raquel: vendor update — extension approved for 4 hours. hold now until 2026-04-15T02:00:00Z. sending confirmation email
anya: perfect. i'll update the scheduling doc and add fallback playbook (a100 mix) in the run notes. thanks all :rocket:
